reciprocal.link: PP051 — Treat creativity as a process, not a trait
reciprocal.why: the Creativity concept page is a one-line seed on the philosophy of creativity (Bergson, Dewey, Nietzsche) and cites no principle; PP051 is the compendium's process reading, grounded in the opened Hennessey and Amabile 2010 review (novel and appropriate definition, training meta-analysis, summary point acknowledging both stable aspects and environmental influence), which is the missing psychological anchor for that page
